name: kimi-code-desktop
description: Unofficial Windows desktop harness for Kimi Code CLI

scripts.build:services: corepack pnpm@10.13.1 --filter @kimi-code-desktop/server build && corepack pnpm@10.13.1 --filter @kimi-code-desktop/web build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm@10.13.1 --filter @kimi-code-desktop/server typecheck && corepack pnpm@10.13.1 --filter @kimi-code-desktop/web typecheck && corepack pnpm@10.13.1 --filter @kimi-code-desktop/desktop typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm@10.13.1 --filter @kimi-code-desktop/server test && corepack pnpm@10.13.1 --filter @kimi-code-desktop/web test && corepack pnpm@10.13.1 --filter @kimi-code-desktop/desktop test && corepack pnpm@10.13.1 test:tooling
scripts.test:tooling: node --test scripts/check-migration-approval.test.mjs scripts/check-public-source.test.mjs scripts/check-release-version.test.mjs scripts/check-third-party-licenses.test.mjs scripts/execute-approved-migration.test.mjs scripts/prepare-bundle.test.mjs scripts/prepare-feed-migration.test.mjs scripts/release-feed.test.mjs
